ai.detailed_summary: A botched execution took place in Texas on Thursday night, lasting more than an hour and causing the prisoner to scream out and beg for relief from his suffering. sources.title: 4 British Men Convicted of Sexually Assaulting Joanne Young

ai.short_summary: Four British men were convicted of sexually assaulting Joanne Young, with the jury rejecting their defense regarding her husband's assurances.
ai.detailed_summary: A jury convicted four British men of sexually assaulting Joanne Young. During the trial, the jury rejected the defendants' argument that they relied on assurances of consent given by Joanne Young's husband. The husband himself has already pleaded guilty to rape in connection with the case.
ai.significance: The convictions underscore the legal stance that third-party assurances do not constitute valid consent in sexual assault cases.
key_facts: Four British men were convicted of sexually assaulting Joanne Young.
The jury rejected the defendants' defense of relying on assurances of consent from the victim's husband.
Joanne Young's husband previously pleaded guilty to rape.
